\section[(dialogue)]{Can, want and why — a first pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R119-first-pass-can-want-and-why}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for next to and opposite.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to be able, to dare, to have to, to be used to, power
  \item a chance, a skill, it is necessary, it is allowed, to not want
  \item to prefer, to desire, to wish for, to miss, a wish
  \item a desire, hope, a longing, why?, why?
  \item for, for, for that reason, and so, a reason
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To be able? (\textbf{queō, quīre}.) To dare? (\textbf{audeō, audēre}.) To have to? (\textbf{dēbeō, dēbēre}.) To be used to? (\textbf{soleō, solēre}.) Power? (\textbf{potestās, potestātis}.) A chance? (\textbf{facultās, facultātis}.) A skill? (\textbf{ars, artis}.) It is necessary? (\textbf{oportet}.) It is allowed? (\textbf{licet}.) To not want? (\textbf{nōlō, nōlle}.) To prefer? (\textbf{mālō, mālle}.) To desire? (\textbf{cupiō, cupere}.) To wish for? (\textbf{optō, optāre}.) To miss? (\textbf{dēsīderō, dēsīderāre}.) A wish? (\textbf{voluntās, voluntātis}.) A desire? (\textbf{cupiditās, cupiditātis}.) Hope? (\textbf{spēs, speī}.) A longing? (\textbf{dēsīderium, dēsīderiī}.) Why?? (\textbf{quārē}.) Why?? (\textbf{quamobrem}.) For? (\textbf{nam}.) For? (\textbf{enim}.) For that reason? (\textbf{ideō}.) And so? (\textbf{itaque}.) A reason? (\textbf{causa, causae}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Places — a second pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R119-second-pass-places}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a reason and because of that.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a reason, because of that, a place, right, left
  \item to here, to there, a theatre, a bath, a military camp
  \item a building, a prison, the main hall of a house, a corner, a street
  \item a step, a library, a food market, an eating-house, an inn
  \item a floor, a well, a bakery, a workshop, a tomb
  \item an open space, a milestone, around, next to, opposite
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A reason? (\textbf{ratiō, ratiōnis}.) Because of that? (\textbf{proptereā}.) A place? (\textbf{locus, locī}.) Right? (\textbf{dexter, dextra, dextrum}.) Left? (\textbf{sinister, sinistra, sinistrum}.) To here? (\textbf{hūc}.) To there? (\textbf{illūc}.) A theatre? (\textbf{theātrum, theātrī}.) A bath? (\textbf{balneum, balneī}.) A military camp? (\textbf{castra, castrōrum}.) A building? (\textbf{aedificium, aedificiī}.) A prison? (\textbf{carcer, carceris}.) The main hall of a house? (\textbf{ātrium, ātriī}.) A corner? (\textbf{angulus, angulī}.) A street? (\textbf{vīcus, vīcī}.) A step? (\textbf{gradus, gradūs}.) A library? (\textbf{bibliothēca, bibliothēcae}.) A food market? (\textbf{macellum, macellī}.) An eating-house? (\textbf{popīna, popīnae}.) An inn? (\textbf{caupōna, caupōnae}.) A floor? (\textbf{pavīmentum, pavīmentī}.) A well? (\textbf{puteus, puteī}.) A bakery? (\textbf{pistrīnum, pistrīnī}.) A workshop? (\textbf{officīna, officīnae}.) A tomb? (\textbf{sepulcrum, sepulcrī}.) An open space? (\textbf{ārea, āreae}.) A milestone? (\textbf{mīliārium, mīliāriī}.) Around? (\textbf{circā}.) Next to? (\textbf{iūxtā}.) Opposite? (\textbf{contrā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
